name: – Julien Sanchez – After § 1 – Am 15
title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 1a. Recalls that the annual PIF report is an important source of information on the protection of the EU’s financial interests; stresses that enhanced transparency is essential, notably through the active participation of civil society and media organisations; emphasises the importance of engaging civil society, the media in general, and investigative journalism in particular, to enhance awareness;
